# An economist and researcher working at the intersection of data, policy, and society.

I am an Economist and Researcher working across applied research, data science, public policy, and data-driven social projects. I hold a double degree in Economics and Government and Public Transformation from Tecnológico de Monterrey.

My work combines quantitative methods, econometrics, data science, and geospatial analysis to study economic and public policy challenges. I work primarily with R and Python, applying statistical analysis, econometric modeling, machine learning, text mining, web scraping, and spatial methods.

My research interests include political economy, public opinion, subnational democracy, public policy, and applied econometrics.

You can check out my <a href="/cv/EMontalvo_CV_Ing.pdf" target="_blank">CV</a>.

Feel free to explore this site to learn more about my publications, current projects, professional experience, and how to get in touch.
